_doc: The class of every Claude Code plugin of cloud-marketplace, declared here (the source), read by cloudy-u-android ac_cloud-superintel tools/derive-ai-data.py for Context > Plugins. Two classes: `skills` = Skills plugins (payload of skills, commands or agents); `performance` = Performance plugins (payload of hooks, MCP servers, LSP, output styles or other tooling that changes how the assistant runs). `primary` is the declared class; a plugin whose payload also carries the other class is listed under its primary class with a badge for the other (derived from the payload folders, never typed). The derivation fails when a plugin is undeclared, declared twice, or its primary is not a class its payload carries.
